subject: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: handshake, gating exceptions & delivery owners
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: initial asks + exception log

Team — looping you in on the CloudSi onboarding packet that arrived this morning. They are an ISV that will be delivered to enterprise customers via SIWave (system integrator). High level asks and potential exceptions are listed below; I need owners and a recommended cadence to resolve before the marketplace listing review on Oct 18. Attachments: cloudsi_requirements_v1.pdf, siwave_gap_matrix.xlsx.

Summary of asks (from CloudSi / SIWave):
- Tenant-level KMS integration (per-tenant CMK) — SIWave says this is a gating security requirement for their customer base.
- Marketplace entitlement mapping — they want a bundled SKU that maps to dedicated capacity in Redwood Dedicated.
- Audit / telemetry export — SIWave needs delivery of audit logs to their Splunk instance for specific events.
- Private listing waiver — CloudSi requests an exception to the standard public-listing timeline because of contractual go-live with a customer on Nov 1.

Immediate questions for product & infra:
1) Feasible to support a per-tenant KMS flow for a single partner as a limited exception?
2) What mapping work is required to surface a bundled SKU in the marketplace and the billing hooks?
3) Can we export the requested set of audit events without adding undue PII exposure?

Please reply with: owner for each line item, rough ETA (days), and whether you recommend an exception for the private listing request. I propose a fast sync this week (30 mins) to go over blockers.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: cloudsi_requirements_v1.pdf (attachment), siwave_gap_matrix.xlsx (attachment)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: initial asks + exception log

Thanks Monica — skimmed the attachments. Quick readback from Product: 
- KMS per-tenant: technically doable but not supported in our hosted offering today. We can scope a limited-surface flow for Dedicated + Private deployments. Work required: KMS key binding at tenant-provision time + UI for key rotation. Estimate: 3-4 sprints (prod + infra work) for a safe MVP if we prioritize.
- Marketplace SKU bundling: the catalog needs a new "bundle" type and billing mapping. Ben, Priyom — are the billing hooks for a bundled Dedicated SKU plumbed?
- Audit exports: we can stream event-level logs but will need an allowlist of event types to avoid leaking derived embeddings or PII. Security review necessary.

Recommend: Support a temporary exception to do a private-listing approval if the partner signs an SOW that covers engineering support and SLAs. I drafted a short playbook outline — attaching proposed_handshake_playbook.md.

Owner proposals: 
- KMS / infra lead: Karthik (owner) — ETA 6-8 weeks for a scoped Dedicated-only path
- SKU / marketplace mapping: Ben + Priyom (owners) — ETA 2 weeks for a mapping prototype
- Audit export / security review: Laura (owner for review) — ETA 1 week to scope allowed events

If everyone agrees, recommend we schedule a 45-min cross-functional sync Tue (Oct 5) to align on scope and SOW ask.

- Laura
Product Manager

---
Attachments: proposed_handshake_playbook.md (attachment)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: CloudSi Partnership <partner@cloudsi.com>, SIWave PM <pm@siwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: initial asks + exception log

Hi Alex (CloudSi) and Rina (SIWave) — forwarding our internal read and proposed owners. Can you confirm the SOW expectations and whether per-tenant KMS is a hard requirement at contract signing?

Proposed next steps:
- CloudSi / SIWave to confirm KMS requirements and any compliance docs they can share (SOC2, penetration test summaries).
- We will scope a Dedicated-only KMS pilot if you accept an accelerated support SOW to cover engineering effort.
- Ben/Priyom to follow up with marketplace SKU mapping questions and draft entitlement mapping.

Can you share availability for a 30–45 min sync on Tue or Wed (Oct 5–6)? Proposed calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/7a9f4b2c

Regards,
Monica
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference

---
Quoted text:
On Sun, Oct 03, 2027 at 09:12 Monica Patel wrote:
> Team — looping you in on the CloudSi onboarding packet that arrived this morning.
> ...
From: Alex Morales <partner@cloudsi.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, SIWave PM <pm@siwave.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: initial asks + exception log

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the internal owners. A few clarifications from CloudSi: 
- KMS is a strong preference for our enterprise customer (they require per-tenant CMKs). If Redwood can support a Dedicated-only pilot and provide KMS binding + rotation hooks, we can sign the SOW immediately.
- We can provide SOC2 Type II report and a redacted pen test summary for the security review.
- For audit exports: SIWave will consume a curated event stream; we can agree a concrete allowlist in the sync.

Attached: cloudsi_kms_requirements.txt (simple list of API expectations).

We are available Oct 5 at 10:00 PT or Oct 6 at 09:00 PT for the sync. Looking forward to the playbook and SOW language.

— Alex Morales
Head of Partnerships, CloudSi
partner@cloudsi.com

---
Attachment: cloudsi_kms_requirements.txt (attachment)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSi + SIWave onboarding: initial asks + exception log

Thanks all — after quick sync we agreed on the following decisions: 
- Approve Dedicated-only KMS pilot as an exception conditioned on an executed SOW that covers engineering effort and limited support. Owner: Karthik Iyer. ETA: 6 weeks for a scoped pilot (prototype + security review).
- Ben / Priyom to produce a marketplace entitlement mapping doc by Oct 12. Owner: Ben Carter + Priyom Das.
- Laura to sign off on audit allowlist and security gating by Oct 8.
- Monica / Marissa to coordinate SOW language and legal intro; deal_id DB-4931 assigned for tracking.

Action items: 
- Monica: draft SOW ask and share with CloudSi by EOD Wed (Oct 6)
- Ben/Priyom: identify billing hooks and mapping questions (document by Oct 12)
- Laura: security review checklist (Oct 8)

I support making a private-listing exception for Oct 18 review contingent on completion of the above and receipt of SOC2 evidence. If the partner misses milestones, we will fall back to standard listing timelines.

Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering
